title: "conditional_probability_workshop"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## 

```{r}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
cond_prob <- read_csv(here("healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv"))
```

```{r}
stroke_plot_data <- cond_prob %>%
  filter(gender %in% c("Female","Male")) %>%
  mutate(stroke = factor(stroke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Stroke", "Stroke")))%>%
  mutate(heart_disease = factor(heart_disease, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Heart Disease", "Heart Disease")))
  
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_plot_data, aes(x = gender, fill = stroke))+
  geom_bar(position = ("dodge"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_plot_data, aes(x = age, fill = stroke))+
  geom_histogram(color = "black")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_plot_data, aes(x = stroke, y = avg_glucose_level, fill = stroke))+
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_plot_data, aes(x = heart_disease, fill = stroke))+
  geom_bar(position = "dodge")
```

P(A)

```{r}
prob_has_hypertension <- cond_prob %>% 
  count(hypertension) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))%>%
  filter(hypertension == 1) |> 
  pull(percent)
prob_has_hypertension
```

```{r}
prob_male <- cond_prob %>%
  count(gender)%>%
  mutate(percent = n/ sum(n))%>%
  filter(gender == "Male")%>%
  pull(percent)
prob_male

```

```{r}
prob_has_heart_disease <- cond_prob%>%
  count(heart_disease)%>%
  mutate(percent = n/ sum(n))%>%
  filter(heart_disease == 1)%>%
  pull(percent)
prob_has_heart_disease
```

P(B)

```{r}

prob_stroke <- cond_prob%>%
  count(stroke)%>%
  mutate(percent = n/ sum(n))%>%
  filter(stroke == 1) |> 
  pull(percent)
prob_stroke
```

P(A\|B) (male, heart disease, hypertension)

```{r}
prob_male_given_stroke <- cond_prob |> 
  count(gender, stroke) %>% 
  group_by(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(stroke == 1, gender == "Male") %>% 
  pull(percent)
prob_male_given_stroke
```

```{r}
prob_heart_disease_given_stroke <- cond_prob %>%
  count(heart_disease, stroke) %>% 
  group_by(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(stroke == 1, heart_disease == 1) %>% 
  pull(percent)
prob_heart_disease_given_stroke
```

```{r}
prob_hypertension_given_stroke <- cond_prob%>%
  count(hypertension, stroke) %>% 
  group_by(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(stroke == 1, hypertension == 1) %>% 
  pull(percent)
prob_hypertension_given_stroke
```

P(B\|A) (male, heart disease, hypertension)

```{r}
(prob_male_given_stroke*prob_stroke)/prob_male
```

```{r}
(prob_heart_disease_given_stroke*prob_stroke)/prob_has_heart_disease
```

```{r}
(prob_hypertension_given_stroke*prob_stroke)/prob_has_hypertension
```
